page.overview:
Who is Idrin Shadowstep?

Idrin Shadowstep is a young elf-orc chronurgist and a member of The Re-Slayer's Take. He is played by Jasper William Cartwright.

Idrin is a young man of elven and orcish descent, with pointed ears but no prominent tusks, dark hair, and skin the color of clay. He wears warm-colored flowing robes with a pattern showing fragments of the starry sky, and matching gold earrings in both ears; he also has painted black nails, and tattoos of the moon and the sun in the back of his left and right hand respectively, that glow when he uses magic.

He is loyal and shrewd, clever, kind and generous, with strong ideals about helping and protecting other people, and enough curiosity and confidence to intervene in situations that catch his attention. He is also insecure about his identity, being terrified of losing himself if he fully remembers his past lives.

Idrin was raised in Xhorhas by a mother and a father who shared stories and advice with him. He was born with the consecuted soul of a member of the Kryn Dynasty, and even though his mother cast a powerful Modify Memory spell to prevent it, presumably during his adolescence he started having visions at night about those past lives (seeing a big ogre, a sword-wielding orcish woman, and a drow man of the Dynasty); although he was told by his father that was a sign of consecution, his mother insisted that those were just dreams, so the young uniya ended up repressing the memories of his past lives. He eventually learned magic and manifested a talent for chronurgy. Idrin ended up leaving Xhorhas following his mother's advice, who might have also used magic so that his father couldn't find him.
